messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout of quota-enforcement v2 (r-2026-03-15-042) to 10% traffic.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 429s observed in canary. 429s up 12x in 5m window. Throttles trending up.
Kiran (oncall): I'm on it — paged. what's the impact? any customer-facing errors?
Maria: Seeing repeated 429 for multiple tenants, looks like exemptions not applied after the deploy. CS reports chats from Acme and FinCorp complaining about rate limits.
Devon: Quick repro from my laptop:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-quota-reason: NO_EXEMPTION
```
Sam: I can trigger the kill-switch for the new quota path. Suggest `quota-v2.disable=true` on canary and then rollback the canary release.
Sam: Command I will run:
```
redwood feature-flag set quota-v2.disable true --env=canary --by sam
```
ops-bot: Feature flag `quota-v2.disable` toggled to true on canary by Sam.
ops-bot: Traffic now routed to quota-v1 for canary. Monitoring: 429 rate now falling back to baseline.
Kiran (oncall): Confirming 200s restored for most endpoints, but still seeing intermittent 429s from a handful of sessions. Collecting request_ids and sample traces.
Jen (CS): Notifying top affected customers: Acme, HealthCo, EduLabs, FinCorp, MediaX. Draft msg sent to CS channel. Will open support tickets.
Leo: Preliminary root-cause: token accounting change in v2 used unsigned wrap logic; when exemption delta was negative it became large positive and causally reduced exemption counts -> over-throttling when account credits dipped below threshold. Need a repro unit for negative deltas.
Devon: I have a small repro harness. Patch in flight to use signed int64 and explicit clamp. Also add test for exemption delta < 0.
Sam: Rolling back the canary release r-2026-03-15-042 entirely while we validate the fix in staging.
ops-bot: Canary rollback initiated by Sam.
Maria: Customer-facing impact: degraded throughput for some paid tenants for ~12 minutes during the bad canary window. No data loss. CS escalation in progress.
Kiran (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing off to Maria for the next 2 hours to monitor regression metrics and coordinate CS updates. :thumbsup:
Maria: Next steps: merge fix, add unit + integration test, run staged canary with synthetic workload, add alert `quota.exemptions.mismatch` (threshold: >5% mismatch over 5m), and schedule postmortem.
Jen (CS): I'll coordinate follow-ups and share incident summary with affected customers after RCA.
Leo: Postmortem owner: Devon. Timeline to full mitigation: patch merged, canary re-run, then gradual roll to 100% with extra monitoring.
Kiran (oncall): Closing note — kill-switch and rollback mitigated immediate impact. Still tracking root cause fix and alerting gaps. Assigned actions to PRs and tasks. :pray:
